info.title: SecurePrompt Gateway API
info.description:
SecurePrompt is an LLM security gateway that sits between enterprise applications and AI providers. It redacts PII/secrets, enforces policy, tracks token costs, and provides governance analytics.
Two auth schemes are used: - **JWT** (`Authorization: Bearer eyJ...`) — dashboard routes - **API Key** (`Authorization: Bearer sp-...`) — gateway + MCP utility routes

post.description: Creates a workspace and its first owner user in a single call. Returns an access/refresh token pair. Returns 403 when public signup is disabled on the deployment. Availability is controlled by the SECUREPROMPT_PUBLIC_SIGNUP_ENABLED server env var.

201.description: Workspace + owner user created. Returns the same token pair shape as POST /v1/auth/token.

403.description: Public signup disabled on this deployment.

post.description: Proxies to the configured LLM provider after PII redaction and policy enforcement. Supports streaming via `stream: true`. Use an API key (`sp-...`) in the Authorization header.

200.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion response, or a server-sent event stream when `stream: true`.

post.summary: Redact PII and secrets from text
post.description: Runs regex + ML NER detection on the input text, replaces detected values with opaque tokens, and returns the redacted text along with the detection list. Respects workspace policy rules (may deny or further redact). Requires an API key.

post.summary: Estimate token count for a text + model pair
post.description: Approximates token count (1 token ≈ 4 characters, GPT-family heuristic). No auth required for this endpoint.
Evaluates workspace policy rules against the given text without making a downstream provider call. Returns whether the request would be allowed and which policy events fired. Requires an API key.

email.description: Primary email for the new owner user. Must be globally unique across all workspaces.

password.description: Plaintext password. Argon2id-hashed server-side; never persisted in the clear.

workspace_name.description: Display name for the new workspace.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when no more pages

prefix.description: First 8 characters of the key (safe to display)

api_key.description: Full plaintext key — shown once, never stored

has_credential.description: True when an encrypted credential is stored

credential.description: Plaintext API key — encrypted before storage
New plaintext key; omit to leave existing unchanged

priority.description: Lower = higher precedence; must be unique per workspace
